description.ncbi_summary: The protein encoded by this gene is a peroxisomal flavoprotein that catalyzes the oxidative deamination of D-aspartate and N-methyl D-aspartate. Flavin adenine dinucleotide or 6-hydroxyflavin adenine dinucleotide can serve as the cofactor in this reaction. Several transcript variants encoding different isoforms have been found for this gene. [provided by RefSeq, Jan 2019].

uniprot_function.text: Selectively catalyzes the oxidative deamination of acidic amino acids (PubMed:1991137, PubMed:20603179, PubMed:23391306, PubMed:25747990, PubMed:28393897, PubMed:28560262, PubMed:28629864, PubMed:29292239, PubMed:31914658, PubMed:32553892, PubMed:9163533). Suppresses the level of D-aspartate in the brain, an amino acid that can act as an agonist for glutamate receptors (PubMed:28560262). Protects the organism from the toxicity of D-amino acids (By similarity). May also function in the intestine (By similarity).
